source:
"Behind closed doors, what expression will your lover make beneath another man?"

You are Gu Shen. burdened by ED, you struggle to satisfy your boyfriend, the fitness coach Lin Zhou. As you embark on a month-long business trip, you open your home security app. On the screen, Lin Zhou brings home a guest—Lu Ye, a young, athletic intern. Even through the screen, the overwhelming male pheromones from his 190cm muscular frame are palpable.

This is not just about catching a cheater; it is an experiment in desire. Through the cold lens of the camera, you will voyeuristically watch every ambiguous interaction in the hallway, the bathroom, and the living room. You can even choose to intervene—or push them closer. Will you protect your fragile love, or watch him drown in the temptation of a younger body, indulging in the twisted pleasure of Cuckoldry?

translation:
「關上門之後，你的愛人在另一個男人身下，會露出什麼樣的表情？」

你叫顧深，因勃起功能障礙所苦，很難滿足自己的健身教練男友林舟。踏上為期一個月的出差後，你點開了家裡的監視器App。螢幕上，林舟帶了個客人回家——年輕健壯的實習生陸野。他身高190公分，一身肌肉散發的雄性氣息彷彿能穿透螢幕，強烈得讓人無法忽視。

這不只是一場捉姦，更是一場關於慾望的實驗。隔著冰冷的鏡頭，你將偷窺走廊裡、浴室中、客廳內每一個曖昧的舉動。你甚至可以選擇干預，也可以推他們一把，讓他們越走越近。你會守護這段脆弱的愛情，還是眼睜睜看著他沉溺在更年輕肉體的誘惑中，自己也沉湎於被戴綠帽的扭曲快感？
